errors.text: The proposed strain-rate range of 10^-4 to 10^2 s^-1 is fundamentally different from the molecular-dynamics regime of 10^8 to 10^10 s^-1, so the explanation does not address the reported strain-rate insensitivity under the actual conditions.

Yield initiation is assigned to surface steps, ledges, and Frank-Read sources, but the target is a periodic bulk model where nucleation occurs at vacancy clusters or locally disordered atoms; free-surface sources are unavailable.
The generated specimen preparation and initial dislocation-density assumptions describe an experimental crystal rather than the annealed approximately 180,000-atom periodic simulation.
